[[Image:Aile Somera map.png|thumb|right|200px|Location]]
'''Aile Somera''' is an archipelago that is controlled by the ''[[Atha'an Miere]]'' and [[Amayar]]. Aile Somara is located west of [[Toman Head]].

==Recent activities==
The ''[[Wavedancer]]'', an ''Atha'an Miere'' [[raker]], sailed to Aile Somera after leaving [[Tanchico]].{{ref/book|4|39}} After the globe of the female [[Choedan Kal]] melted on [[Tremalking]], the [[Amayar]] began asking the Sea Folk for the gift of Passage.{{ref/book|11|22}}
